name: J-UNIWARD
summary: J-UNIWARD uses a wavelet-based distortion measure for changes to JPEG coefficients. The lab shows where changes fall in the selected image's cost ranking.
strength: Students can compare the placement score with the original image and its coefficient histogram.
weaknesses: The score does not establish a universal detection threshold. Recompressing a JPEG can change its coefficients and invalidate stored data.
lineage: F5 (2001) → nsF5 (2007, shrinkage fix) → J-UNIWARD (2013, adaptive cost + STC)
